lessons.claim: A used_by field naming a file that does not exist is an unwired checker in document form. The Mason-Weitz distillation declared used_by: simbot/analysis/microrheo.py and that file never existed (simbot/analysis holds only structure.py and trap.py). It could not exist there either - simbot imports bdbot in 4 modules, so a bdbot case calling an estimator under simbot/analysis would be an import cycle, and all 8 real cases run through bdbot. Written 2026-09-02 as bdbot/microrheo.py. Check used_by targets resolve when distilling.
